parse.title: Mourning's End Part II/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
====Chest #5====
=====Part 1=====
[[File:Mourning's End Part II - chest 5 solution - part 1.png|275px|right|thumb|Chest #5, part 1.]]
{{Checklist|
*Reset the puzzle
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #1 points north.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #2 points west.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #3 points south.
*Place the {{plink|Yellow crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Yellow crystal}}. The light will turn yellow.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #4 points east.
*Cross the gap to the other side.
*Place the {{plink|Blue crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Blue crystal}}.
*Remove {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #4.
*Rotate {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #3 points up.
*Use the south stairs to head to the top floor.}}{{clear}}

=====Part 2=====
[[File:Mourning's End Part II - chest 5 solution - part 2.png|275px|right|thumb|Chest #5, part 2.]]
{{Checklist|
*Place {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #4 in the new position pointing south.
*Place the {{plink|Fractured crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Fractured crystal|pic=Fractured crystal (horizontal)}}.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #5 makes the western light point down. Long side of the mirror should be pointing east.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #6 makes the southern light point east.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #7 points down. Long side of the mirror should be pointing west.
*Go to the bottom floor.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #8 points south.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #9 points east.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #10 points north.
*Open the chest to obtain 3 mirrors and a second {{plink|Fractured crystal (horizontal)|txt=Fractured crystal}}.
}}{{clear}}
